text:
Jason_AE: FYI Keystone Retail POC started load warmup this morning and we're seeing intermittent 503s + some 429 spikes. Customer is about to demo tomorrow, need a quick triage swarm.
Sara_Sales: Noted. Customer on trial credits, demo at 16:00 PDT. Can we get a priority triage? @Tyler_SE can you grab logs?
Tyler_SE: looking now. reproducing 503s when concurrent requests > 80. attaching minimal curl test.
Tyler_SE: ```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxxx' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"xlarge-2","input":"hello","max_tokens":8}'
```
Tyler_SE: response headers: `x-redwood-reqid: rq_12345`, `x-redwood-swarm-node: gpu07`, body: 503 Service Unavailable or 429 Rate limit exceeded.
Maria_SRE: seeing a pattern — node gpu07 entered degraded mode and dropped to 0.6 throughput after a background GC. Autoscaler didn't shift traffic fast enough.
Maria_SRE: temp mitigation: route this customer's traffic to the standby pool (gpu11,gpu12) and enable conservative batching.
Devon_Support: I can flip routing, need a greenlight from eng-oncall. Also customer wants clarification on pricing if we route to Dedicated.
Jason_AE: give the greenlight. They need stable demo; we'll follow up on pricing later.
ops-bot: @eng-oncall deploy-check: autoscaler healthy: 86% nodes ready. routing-policy change requested by Devon_Support.
Tyler_SE: quick config to route by header: set `x-robin-priority: keystone-poc` on requests and add to route table. Pushing snippet to #eng-platform.
Gwen_Security: small note — customer SQ (security questionnaire) asks about data at rest key management. We answered earlier but they want KMS HSM details. Linking file: https://redwood.sec/keystone/sq-response-v2.pdf
Ryan_Product: if this becomes recurring we should offer short-term Dedicated pool for the demo (2 weeks). Finance ok to approve trial reserved capacity credits?
Jason_AE: I'll confirm with customer. We may need a one-time capacity bump.
Maria_SRE: for immediate heat: increase per-node concurrency limit from 80 -> 120 for standby pool and disable preemptive GC on gpu11 for next 2 hours.
Devon_Support: done — changed route table and bumped concurrency. Monitoring now.
Tyler_SE: retesting with same curl => 200 OK 99% success for 10k hits. No 503s observed in last 5m.
Sara_Sales: customer pinged — seeing improvements on their side, demo stays. :tada:
Gwen_Security: still need to send full KMS appendix to their security team. Jason, can you forward the signed NDA so I can include the appendix?
Jason_AE: yes sending NDA now.
ops-bot: alert resolved: route-change succeeded, nodes scaled.
Maria_SRE: follow-up action items: 1) autoscaler tweak to shift load faster on degraded nodes (ticket ENG-8642), 2) add warmup traffic policy for POCs (DOCS-459), 3) postmortem if we see recurrence.
Ryan_Product: capture pricing for 2-week Dedicated trial and share with customer by EOD.
Devon_Support: I'll add customer to an extended trial credits pool and log the change.
Sara_Sales: thanks all — great quick turn. If anything flares before 16:00 PDT ping this thread and I'll escalate.
Jason_AE: demo confirmed at 16:00 PDT. Closing swarm for now.
Devon_Support: note: saved logs and reqids for follow-up: rq_12345, rq_12346, rq_12347.
Tyler_SE: sending short recap + minimal repro steps to the customer Slack channel.
Gwen_Security: I'll attach KMS appendix once NDA is in.
Maria_SRE: leaving temporary guardrails for 2h. Will revert changes at 19:30 PDT unless we extend.
Sara_Sales: :thumbsup: everyone.
Jason_AE: thanks team — great work.
